entries.title: Abraham
entries.descriptionMarkdown:
Abraham was son of [Terah](entry://person/terah) (תֶּרַח)
Abraham had **at least 8 sons** mentioned by name:
#### **1) By Sarah (his wife)**

- [Isaac](entry://person/isaac) (יִצְחָק) — the main “covenant” son in Genesis.

#### **2) By Hagar (Sarah’s servant)**

- [Ishmael](entry://person/ishmael) (יִשְׁמָעֵאל)

#### **3) By Keturah (later wife/concubine after Sarah)**

Genesis 25 lists 6 sons:

- **Zimran**
- **Jokshan**
- **Medan**
- **Midian**
- **Ishbak**
- **Shuah**

entries.title: Isaac
entries.descriptionMarkdown:
Isaac was the son of [Abraham](entry://person/abraham)
Isaac had **two sons**, twins, with **Rebekah**:

- [Esau](entry://person/esau) (עֵשָׂו)
- [Jacob (Israel)](entry://person/jacob-israel) (יַעֲקֹב) — later renamed **Israel** (יִשְׂרָאֵל)

entries.title: Jacob (Israel)
entries.descriptionMarkdown:
Son of [Isaac](entry://person/isaac)
Jacob (Israel) had **12 sons** — they become the **12 tribes of Israel**.

#### **By Leah**
- **Reuben**
- **Simeon**
- **Levi**
- [Judah](entry://person/judah)
- **Issachar**
- **Zebulun**
#### **By Rachel**
- [Joseph - son of Jacob](entry://person/joseph-son-of-jacob)
- **Benjamin**
#### **By Bilhah (Rachel’s servant)**
- **Dan**
- **Naphtali**
#### **By Zilpah (Leah’s servant)**
- **Gad**
- **Asher**
